configJson: {"version": 1, "themeUuid": "fce3f3a0-826f-11f1-b08c-f4053e2709b9", "conditions": [], "sqlPreview": "SELECT DISTINCT s.client_id AS patient_id FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_summary s INNER JOIN person p ON s.client_id = p.person_id WHERE s.baseline_regimen_start_date IS NOT NULL AND s.baseline_regimen_start_date >= :startDate AND s.baseline_regimen_start_date < :endDate AND DATEDIFF(:endDate, s.baseline_regimen_start_date) >= 365 AND s.transfer_out_date IS NULL AND COALESCE(s.lost_to_followup, \"\") != \"Yes\" AND (p.death_date IS NULL OR p.death_date > :endDate)", "themeConfig": {"fields": [{"key": "client", "expr": "client_id", "type": "number", "label": "Client"}, {"key": "gender", "expr": "gender", "type": "coded", "label": "Gender"}, {"key": "baseline_regimen_start_date", "expr": "baseline_regimen_start_date", "type": "date", "label": "ART Start Date"}], "conditions": [{"key": "baseline_regimen_start_date", "label": "Baseline Regimen Start Date", "column": "baseline_regimen_start_date", "handler": "DATE_RANGE", "operator": "BETWEEN", "valueType": "date"}, {"key": "transfer_out_date", "label": "Not Transferred Out", "column": "transfer_out_date", "handler": "TEXT", "operator": "IS_NULL", "valueType": "boolean"}, {"key": "lost_to_followup", "label": "Not Lost to Follow-up", "column": "lost_to_followup", "handler": "TEXT", "operator": "!=", "valueType": "coded"}], "dateColumn": "baseline_regimen_start_date", "sourceTable": "mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_summary", "patientIdColumn": "client_id"}}
sqlTemplate: SELECT DISTINCT s.client_id AS patient_id FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_summary s INNER JOIN person p ON s.client_id = p.person_id WHERE s.baseline_regimen_start_date IS NOT NULL AND s.baseline_regimen_start_date >= :startDate AND s.baseline_regimen_start_date < :endDate AND DATEDIFF(:endDate, s.baseline_regimen_start_date) >= 365 AND s.transfer_out_date IS NULL AND COALESCE(s.lost_to_followup, "") != "Yes" AND (p.death_date IS NULL OR p.death_date > :endDate)
